summary: Implemented and root-reproduced a standard-library worker-owned JSONL event recorder and deterministic local interval overlap summarizer through RED/GREEN tests.

claims.claim: Current and immutable revision 1 contracts are byte-identical.
Each stream is exclusively created and accepts only append-only events from one task revision.
evidence: Same-owner append preserves the accepted prefix; owner mismatch and first-claim races fail with stable codes.

claims.claim: Transition and timestamp validation fail closed.
evidence: UNKNOWN_EVENT, OWNER_MISMATCH, DUPLICATE_TRANSITION, OUT_OF_ORDER_TRANSITION, FINISH_BEFORE_START, and INCOMPLETE_SPAN paths are covered.

claims.claim: Closed intervals are classified deterministically and --require-overlap exits 1 when no pair overlaps.
evidence: Ten targeted tests pass, including overlapping boundary, non-overlap, stable summary, and non-overwrite cases.

uncertainty: Timestamps support comparison only for streams recorded on the same local host clock; they do not prove scheduler performance or reconcile cross-host clock drift.
